patterns.name: Static-Performance Dispatch
patterns.description: Initialization-time selection of the best available function pointer based on CPUID/HWCAP. Eliminates runtime branching in hot loops.
patterns.usage: Used in AdaptiveCuckooFilter (CuckooKernel struct), Hash dispatcher (SHA-256/RIPEMD-160), and Secp256k1 backend selection.

patterns.name: Batch-SIMD Processing
patterns.description: Grouping independent operations (like 4 or 8 hashes) into a single SIMD pipeline to maximize throughput instead of trying to parallelize a single operation.
patterns.usage: Used in SHA256-AVX2, RIPEMD160-NEON, Adaptive Filter batch lookup, and batch_normalize for Jacobian-to-Affine conversion.

patterns.name: Hardware-Aware Auto-Tune
patterns.description: Scaling engine parameters (batch size, thread count) based on the detected ISA level and cache hierarchy.
patterns.usage: Implemented in system/hardware.cpp (detect_hardware), engine/app.cpp (auto-tune profiles: safe/balanced/max).

patterns.name: ISA-Per-File Separation
patterns.description: Each ISA variant gets its own .cpp/.hpp file instead of #ifdef blocks within a single file. Improves readability and compile-time isolation.
patterns.usage: All SIMD kernels: sha256-{sse4,avx,avx2,avx512,arm64}.cpp, ripemd160-{sse4,avx2,neon}.cpp, secp256k1-{sse4,avx2,avx512,arm64}.hpp, adaptive_filter_{avx2,avx512,sse4,neon}.cpp.

patterns.name: Manual Prefetching
patterns.description: Explicit _mm_prefetch / __builtin_prefetch instructions in SIMD batch lookup loops to hide memory latency for irregular access patterns.
patterns.usage: Introduced in Phase 11 in adaptive_filter_{avx2,avx512,sse4,neon}.cpp with distance i+1. Phase 12 plans to extend to distance 4-8.

patterns.name: Atomic Signal Handling
patterns.description: std::atomic<bool> flags (g_stop_requested) for cooperative shutdown. Signal handler sets flag, worker threads poll it each iteration.
patterns.usage: All three engines (kangaroo.cpp, bsgs.cpp, address.cpp). Checkpoint save triggered in main thread after signal, not in handler.

patterns.name: Structure-of-Arrays (SoA) Fleet
patterns.description: Kangaroo fleet stores point coordinates in SoA layout (separate arrays for x[0..3], y[0..3]) instead of AoS, enabling SIMD-width operations across all fleet members simultaneously.
patterns.usage: core/secp256k1_fleet.hpp defines FleetState with 1024-lane SoA. engine/kangaroo.cpp processes fleet in SIMD batches.
